description: N59 piano lines from the N59 'Piano (D)' 2-bar tables (A aeolian over Am7). The rhythm is walked over the whole 2-bar cycle (no half-bar form); the last note of each cycle is drawn from the tables. Rhythm seed varies by track only, melody seed by cycle only. 16 tracks x 200 cycles = 400 bars. No chord shifting or filtering.
